# Quantum groups and quantum affine algebras {#sec-quantum-groups}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false title="Learning goals"}
- Work with $U_q(sl_2)$ and its representations for generic $q$ and at roots of unity.
- Use the Hopf-algebra structure: coproduct, antipode and counit.
- Define the Drinfeld–Jimbo algebras $U_q(\hat g)$ and their evaluation representations.
- Derive the Yang–Baxter equation, crossing and unitarity from the universal R-matrix.
- Understand Hermitian forms for $\lvert q\rvert=1$.
:::

::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple" title="To be written"}
Sources to draw on: Jimbo 1985, 1986; Drinfeld 1987; Chari–Pressley, *A Guide to Quantum Groups*; Gómez–Ruiz-Altaba–Sierra, *Quantum Groups in Two-Dimensional Physics*; Delius 1995.
:::
